The date-only candidate includes the hours before 9:00am on 2 February 2026; launch-based candidates exclude them. Preserve the competing interpretations of "With effect from 2 February 2026" and "following its implementation" alongside the explicit operational launch time. The present pair findings do not resolve this temporal issue.
